unverifiedItems: Sources re-fetched live on 2026-10-16 (HTTP status and hashes in sourcesRef); the author checked the page claims against the sections listed there. The module Java-SME critic has not yet re-verified them.

Program outputs and javac messages shown on the page and produced by the practice editor were compared with a local JDK 17.0.12 javac/java run on 2026-10-16, not with JDK 25; the cited SE 25 rules are unchanged for these constructs, but a JDK 25 run has not been recorded.

The JetBrains pages name Resume (F9) but do not spell out that execution continues to the next breakpoint; that description is standard debugger behavior, shown by the practice debugger, and awaits SME confirmation.

The IntelliJ IDEA control names and the gutter breakpoint and Debug workflow were checked against the JetBrains help pages listed in sourcesRef; the practice debugger does not reproduce IDE-specific views such as inline values, watches or the Run to Cursor action.
